title: Anthropic launches Live Artifacts for real-time dashboards #anthropic #liveartifacts #aitechnology
description: Anthropic released Live Artifacts, a new feature in Claude that creates real, auto-updating dashboards. Unlike traditional static reports, these dashboards stay connected to your live data and refresh automatically every time you open them. Live Artifacts enables users to build trackers, KPI boards, project management tools, and content calendars directly inside Claude with one-time setup for continuous use. This innovation simplifies data monitoring by eliminating manual updates, making business insights more accessible and timely. The technology is especially valuable for teams and individuals who rely on up-to-date performance metrics, improving decision-making speed and operational efficiency. #Anthropic #ClaudeAI #LiveArtifacts #AIDashboard #DataAutomation #KPItracking #BusinessIntelligence #ProjectManagement #AItools #ProductivitySoftware #TechInnovation #AutoUpdatingDashboards #DataVisualization #AIForBusiness #WorkflowAutomation
